claim: In July 2026 TSMC raised its 2026 capital budget guidance to US$60-64 billion, with 10-20% for advanced packaging, testing, mask making and others.
evidence: "raised its capital budget for 2026 to between US$ 60 billion and US$ 64 billion"; "between 10 and 20 percent for advanced packaging, testing, mask making, and others" (W.Media, 16 Jul 2026, reporting TSMC 2Q26 call)
